title: DiCALM: Converting Autoregressive Convolution-Attention Language Models into Discrete Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing methods for adapting autoregressive (AR) language models to diffusion generation focus mainly on full-attention architectures. More efficient hybrid architectures remain underexplored. We introduce DiCALM, a recipe for converting the hybrid convolution-attention models of the LFM2 family (LFM2 and LFM2.5) from AR to masked-diffusion generation. DiCALM progressively extends LFM2's causal gated convolution so that it captures local context in both directions. It combines this extension with a masking warm-up and joint AR--diffusion training. In controlled experiments, DiCALM performs comparably to the corresponding fine-tuned LFM2.5-based AR models and delivers consistent speedups over them at both the 350M and 1.2B scales: over 1.4x on average and up to 1.79x.

translated_title: DiCALM：将自回归卷积-注意力语言模型转换为离散扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 现有将自回归（AR）语言模型适配到扩散生成的方法主要集中于全注意力架构，而更高效的混合架构仍未得到充分探索。我们提出DiCALM，这是一种将LFM2家族（LFM2和LFM2.5）的混合卷积-注意力模型从自回归转换为掩码扩散生成的方案。DiCALM逐步扩展LFM2的因果门控卷积，使其能够双向捕获局部上下文，并将这一扩展与掩码预热及AR-扩散联合训练相结合。在对照实验中，DiCALM的性能与相应的基于LFM2.5微调的自回归模型相当，并在350M和1.2B两个规模上都实现了一致的加速：平均超过1.4倍，最高达1.79倍。
tldr: DiCALM首次提出将混合卷积-注意力语言模型（LFM2家族）从自回归转换为掩码扩散生成的方案，通过双向扩展因果门控卷积、掩码预热和AR-扩散联合训练，在保持性能相当的同时实现平均1.4倍、最高1.79倍的推理加速。
en_tdlr: DiCALM introduces the first recipe for converting hybrid convolution-attention language models (LFM2 family) from autoregressive to masked-diffusion generation, achieving consistent speedups of over 1.4x on average and up to 1.79x while maintaining comparable performance.
